_doc: Parts of this pack (group ai-kit). Board-scope gate: scripts/board_gate.py.
name: PSOC Edge E84 AI Kit (KIT_PSE84_AI) on-board parts

sensors.label: BMI270 0x68 / DPS368 0x77 / SHT40 0x44 on SCB0, BMM350 0x15 on I3C

mics.label: 2x IM73D122 PDM mics (P8.5/P8.6) + 2x IM73A135 analog mics (P14.x)

audio.label: TLV320DAC3100 audio DAC 0x18 (SCB0 + I2S TDM0), speaker J8 (not fitted)

wireless.label: CYW55513 Wi-Fi 6 / Bluetooth 5.4 (Murata 2FY, SDIO + SCB4 UART)

display.label: MIPI-DSI connector J10 + J16 touch header (not fitted) + SCB5 3.3 V I2C

camera.label: USB camera on J2 (Rev *A+) / DVP header J14 (before Rev *A)

memory.label: QSPI NOR 64 MB (SMIF0) + octal PSRAM 16 MB (SMIF1)
